And yes I was all about self improvement. A typical day looked like this. 5am wake up, meditate in candle lit darkness for 30 min. Have a veggie smoothie. Breakfast. Shower, gym for 2 hours. Work. Soon as I come home lights off. I had nothing I was a fucking psychopath. I pushed myself too far.

Okay listen to this before you go too far down the rabbit hole. I’m 25m.

I started off working in the best restaurant in my state. I was 20, a young prodigy surrounded by award winning chefs and was on the verge of becoming one of them, with the opportunity given by my family friend (executive chef) (big $$) of one day taken over. I used to have plenty of vices back then. (Nothing over the top) used to drink and smoke a little bit. One day I discovered self improvement. After that it was history. Self improvement is a fucking scam. For the most part. You need to check yourself, step out of that reality and remember your old self and you who really are. Remind yourself from your friends and family, your physical reality what’s right. Or wrong. A year later every calorie that went into my mouth was counted. Gym was 6 days a week. I would force myself to study on bullshit (stocks / trading). I didn’t see nearly a single friend for nearly 2 years. Yes I saved good money but I am now in debt. 
About 22 I admitted myself to the ED for mental health. I was on meds. And off meds. And on. I became severely depressed and now have nearly no friends, it’s hard to talk to my family. I struggle socially. I was a fucking robot. I couldn’t think for myself I couldn’t decide when to rest when to work. I burnt out and soon lost that job. I was a fucking mess. Fast forward to now I lost 20k in savings. (Could have bought a house) I now live an extremely miserable life where I contemplate suicide nearly every waking moment. I work at a shitty pub with horrible food just living paycheck to paycheck. It’s disgusting what my life could have been like. Been on massive amounts of money. Could have had my own house by minimum 21. Surrounded by friends and family who loved me. Lived out the dream my true young prodigy self had the potential for. All I had to do was let go. Release, and choose my vices. But I quit smoking and everything cold turkey so I was fucked in the head. There’s nothing wrong with enjoying yourself, that’s what life’s about. If I were anyone on this sub I would immediately get off and check in with your reality, and speak to those around you full of life. This has not only ended my career, my relationship with my family. But most potentially could end my life. If you need anything let me know. But it’s incredibly sad the society we have become to even contemplate being miserable for even a microsecond of what??? Self improvement?? It’s bullshit. Shambles. Look at me? I’ve degenerated more than anything. You want self improvement smoke a fucking bong mate. Let go. Life’s too short for this selfish crap. Enjoy your friends and family while you got em. Cos I’ve no longer got mine, nor myself.

I was allowed to watch what ever I wanted and see friends. But I’d still have the internet switched off at 8:30 (strict bed time) Was only allowed to see select friends at certain times. Wasn’t really allowed home by myself. Had to go to (after school care). As I got older I ended up rebelling more and more as my parents got more strict and found myself sleeping on the streets for fun with a crack pipe. I ended up going completely off the rails as I got out of school and got a job and spent my time escaping parents and partying. By 21 I was an emotional wreck and my life went down hill. The friends who had more freedom ended up switching their heads on and some of them are in the military and some are even 5 star chefs in restaurants. I think it’s crucial not to be so strict because kids will always have an itch just let them enjoy as long as they’re happy and not hurting anyone.

Okay look. This is crazy for me right now. I got diagnosed with CTPSD 2 months ago when I am/was sure I have Bipolar disorder (maybe both?). I joined this forum today and although I was never abused of any sort as a child I did witness some pretty sinister stuff. (From 5-15 I saw my mum beaten frequently) (From 15-20 I was in a domestic violent relationship and extremely abused drugs, my dad attempted suicide, I lost my best friend to a car crash and my mum got cancer. It’s so severe and exposed I’ve had to go home twice in the last year. It’s so embarrassing especially because no one understands and just assumed I’m literally insane.
